label: TDI injector failure causing misfire and rough idle
symptom: Engine runs rough with a noticeable tapping noise and misfire, engine warning light on, glow plug light flashing.
cause: Piezo injectors failing or circuit failure; excessive carbon buildup can cause seizure.
fix: Replace or repair the faulty injectors, program new calibration codes to ECU, and clean injector bore if seized.
inspection_advice: Check for misfire codes and listen for irregular engine idle.

label: Water pump failure and seal damage on TDI engines
symptom: Coolant leak from the water pump after installation; potential coolant circulation issues or pump failure.
cause: Electronic water pump actuator complexity; dry rotation during installation damages the mechanical seal.
fix: Replace with modified aftermarket pump that bypasses electronic actuator if needed; pre-lubricate pump with coolant before installation to prevent seal damage.
inspection_advice: Inspect for coolant leaks around the water pump and check service history for replacement.

label: Timing chain stretch, tensioner failure, and cam bridge issues
symptom: Engine timing issues, potential for severe engine damage; oil flow restriction to variator, potential camshaft timing issues; oil leak from cam bridge area after timing chain replacement.
cause: Chain stretch beyond specified limits (e.g., 61-64 link measurement); screen in cam bridge becomes blocked or broken; original seal design is difficult to reinstall correctly and prone to leaking.
fix: Replace timing chain kit and tensioner, verify timing marks; replace cam bridge assembly during timing chain service; replace seal with new one during reassembly; critical to prevent rework.
inspection_advice: Check timing chain stretch measurement and inspect cam bridge for leaks or screen blockage.

notes: Multiple related cam bridge issues (screen blockage, seal leak) often addressed during timing chain service.

label: PCV valve oil ingestion and inadequate air-oil separator
symptom: Excessive knock correction (up to 18 degrees) during hard cornering or track use, indicating oil ingestion into the intake; oil ingestion into the intake system, particularly during dynamic driving.
cause: Stock Mk7 PCV valve design overwhelmed during hard braking/cornering, allowing oil to bypass the air-oil separator and enter the intake manifold; Mk7 PCV valve has a small air-oil separator drain hole and a bypass valve that opens under pressure differential, allowing oil to flood the diaphragm assembly.
fix: Retrofit Mk8 PCV valve (revision B) with a 2021 Tiguan PCV hose and cap the unused port; Mk8 PCV valve features a revised separator with a larger drain outlet and improved bypass valve material.
inspection_advice: Check for oil in the intake manifold and PCV valve condition, especially if used for performance driving.

label: Thermostat housing prone to leaking
symptom: Coolant leak from the thermostat housing area, often with sweet-smelling vapor under the hood.
fix: Replace thermostat housing and water pump assembly; often requires intake manifold removal for proper cleaning and installation.
inspection_advice: Inspect thermostat housing area for coolant residue or leaks.

cause: Manufacturer-specified 5-year replacement interval regardless of mileage.
fix: Replace timing belt and water pump every 5 years.
